## Enhancing CSS overrides  
- Added custom properties (--p-color-*) to override Porsche's internal variables in CSS.  
- Used multiple selectors for maximum specificity in styling.  
- Included global CSS variables for consistent theme application.  
- Ensured overrides maintain compatibility with existing Porsche styles.  
- Focused on improving customization without breaking original layout.
